scope: NG source motion only. Root and scene_status own Godot playback, exits, interruptions and behavior checks.

Black silhouettes can hide the scratch paw. Husky rear-angle 60Hz review confirmed its ear-side motion; final runtime dense capture remains separate.
Cat original 20-bone rig has no independent ear/toe articulation. Cat scratch remains the original explicitly deferred action.
